DATABASE_URL.description: Optional. Direct Postgres URL when STORAGE=postgres (no PgBouncer transaction pooler). Leave empty to use Cloudflare D1.

DB.description: Cloudflare D1 database (default storage). Auto-created as `openoutreach`.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client ID (Gmail send + readonly).

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Microsoft Entra app ID for Outlook/Microsoft 365 send + read.

CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generate: `openssl rand -hex 32`. **Do not rotate** after connecting Gmail accounts.

MCP_BEARER_TOKEN.description: Generate: `openssl rand -hex 32`. MCP clients use `Authorization: Bearer …`.

TRACKING_HMAC_SECRET.description: Generate: `openssl rand -hex 32`. Signs open/click tracking tokens.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public origin, e.g. `https://openoutreach.<account>.workers.dev` or your custom domain.

CF_ACCESS_AUD.description: Cloudflare Access application AUD tag. Required when AUTH_MODE=cloudflare_access.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Better Auth cookie/session secret when AUTH_MODE=hosted. Generate: `openssl rand -hex 32`.

AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated allowlist. Access policy (default) and Better Auth signup (hosted).

FEATURE_CF_EMAIL.description: Optional. Set to `1` to enable Cloudflare Email Sending accounts (transactional; needs Email Routing to this Worker for replies).
